facts.value: ASU only accepts credit from regionally accredited institutions.
Questions about accreditation can be referred to your transfer institution or to ASU Admissions Services.
Build a Transfer Map may not be compatible with institutions that have highly unique or experimental methods of instruction, including great books-, thesis-, or seminar-based curricula.
Students from institutions that fall into this scenario are encouraged to work with an Academic Advisor or transfer specialist.
If you are still unable to locate your institution, please contact the provided email address for assistance.
We recommend using a desktop computer with Firefox or Chrome web browser.
